user.title: Connect Buffer
user.description: Create a personal API key at {api_url} and paste it below.

data_description.api_key: Your Buffer API key. It only grants access to your own Buffer account.

organization.title: Choose organization
organization.description: Your Buffer account belongs to several organizations. Pick the one to add (you can add the others later).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Buffer
reauth_confirm.description: Your Buffer API key is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Buffer API.
error.no_organizations: This API key has no organizations.
error.wrong_account: This API key does not have access to the organization that was originally set up.

abort.already_configured: This Buffer organization is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: Each poll uses one API request. Buffer allows 250 requests per day on Free/Essentials plans, so keep this at 15 minutes or more.

create_post.name: Create post
create_post.description: Creates a post on one or more Buffer channels.

device_id.name: Channels
device_id.description: Buffer channel devices to post to.

due_at.name: Publish at
due_at.description: Specific publish time. Setting this implies 'Schedule at a specific time'.

image_urls.name: Image URLs
image_urls.description: Public, stable HTTPS URLs of images to attach. Buffer fetches them when publishing.

save_to_draft.name: Save as draft
save_to_draft.description: Save as a draft instead of scheduling.

create_idea.name: Create idea
create_idea.description: Saves an idea to Buffer's Ideas board for later review.

config_entry_id.name: Organization
config_entry_id.description: The Buffer organization to save the idea to.

unknown_channel.message: Buffer channel {channel} was not found in any loaded Buffer organization.

not_a_channel_device.message: Device {device} is not a Buffer channel.

due_at_required.message: 'Publish at' is required when mode is 'Schedule at a specific time'.

entry_not_loaded.message: That Buffer organization is not loaded.
